doc: Where each IMR Lecture 6 photo in img/ was found online (ROADMAP 'Trace IMR lecture photos to their original source'; study: docs/reviews/2026-11-15-imr-lecture-photo-sources-study.md). A record, read by no page and no tool: it changes no photo, credit or licence (the credits wait for Pierre's answers in the study). found: 'original' = the same picture (pixel-matched, then checked by eye) on a page that names its photographer; 'copy-only' = the same picture found only on pages that name no photographer; 'none' = not found in what was searched (searched below). source: the page, the picture, the species and place it is captioned with, its photographer, the match score; licence: what the source states for the picture, null when it states none (see terms). shot: the picture's file name in the deck (a screenshot's name holds the day it was taken), null when the deck names none.

searched.deck: Lecture 6 Google Slides copy: each picture's title, description and link read; the only text found is a file name ('Screen Shot <day> at <time>' for 64 of the 120 pictures, taken 2018-11-21 to 2020-10-26); no link, credit or source.
searched.exif: The 120 files in img/ carry no EXIF or XMP metadata.
searched.yandex: Yandex reverse image search on each of the 120 photos (its public R2 address), no captcha; the first 60 pictures it returned for each were downloaded and compared.
searched.cotw: Corals of the World (coralsoftheworld.org): every species page of each genus under its current name and its former names (1172 page addresses tried, 5705 gallery pictures compared).
searched.inaturalist: iNaturalist, through tools/inat.py: for every genus, the taxon photos of the genus and its species and the photos of Philippine observations created up to 2020-10-31 (2104 photos); then, for the 21 genera with a photo still untraced, every photo of their Philippine observations, of any date and grade (5863 photos). No match.
searched.commons: Wikimedia Commons: the first 40 pictures of a file search on the genus name, for Acropora, Astrea, Danafungia (82 pictures compared): no match; Wikimedia throttled this session's requests, so these genera with an untraced photo were not reached: Diploastrea, Dipsastraea, Echinopora, Favites, Galaxea, Hydnophora, Lobactis, Lobophyllia, Montipora, Mycedium, Pachyseris, Pavona, Pectinia, Pocillopora, Seriatopora, Stylophora, Tubastraea, Turbinaria
searched.match: Same picture = ORB features with a RANSAC homography, at least 100 consistent points (crops and resizes pass); every Corals of the World match and the copies of the two copy-only photos were then looked at side by side (the other copies listed were not all opened). Different photos of similar corals scored at most 35; a thumbnail about 100 px wide of the same picture scored 28 to 87, so the Corals of the World pass used the full gallery pictures.

cotw.name: Corals of the World terms of use
cotw.says: Content may be used 'in unaltered form for personal, non-commercial use only', and 'for academic and research purposes provided the appropriate citation, crediting Corals of the World, is used'; photographs owned by third parties are excepted ('The intellectual property rights remain with the third party'); 'all other intellectual property rights are reserved'; other uses need Corals of the World's written approval (contact@coralsoftheworld.org).

source.author: Russell Kelley, Rachel Pears and Phil Woodhead

imrl-p10_i2.note: Found only on aquarium sites. The earliest dated copy found is a 2aqua.com forum thread whose first post is dated 2014-08-25; it names no author or source.

imrl-p19_i8.note: The same picture is the thumbnail of the YouTube video 'Sun Coral (Tubastrea) - Care and why I am giving mine up' (channel 'Inappropriate Reefer'). The video's date could not be read here, so whether the channel is the origin is not confirmed.
